template_metadata.purpose: Ready-to-use consultation frameworks for professional astrologers
template_metadata.scope: Templates for common consultation types with talking points and structure

talking_points: Welcome and introduce yourself
Explain what natal astrology is and isn't (potentials, not fate)
Ask about client's astrology knowledge level
Set expectations: 'We'll cover your core personality, relationships, career, and life purpose'
Ask client's main questions or areas of focus
Confirm birth data accuracy

section_1_big_three.title: Your Core Identity: Sun, Moon, and Rising
talking_points: Sun sign and house: 'This is your core identity, life purpose, what you're here to express'
Moon sign and house: 'This is your emotional nature, what you need to feel secure, your inner child'
Rising sign: 'This is how you appear to others, your approach to life, your life path'
Explain any conflicts or harmony between these three
Use evolutionary zodiac narrative if appropriate
Apply theatrical metaphor: 'Your Sun is the actor, in the sign's atmosphere, on the house's stage'
section_1_big_three.client_reflection: Ask: 'Does this resonate with how you see yourself and how others see you?'

section_2_relationships.title: Love and Relationships
talking_points: Venus sign and house: 'This is what you value, how you love, what attracts you'
Mars sign and house: 'This is what you desire, your passion, your sexual expression'
7th house and its ruler: 'This describes your ideal partner and partnership style'
Venus-Mars aspects: chemistry and compatibility style
Challenging aspects: 'These show relationship lessons you're learning'
If applicable: Sexual archetype themes from 5th/8th house emphasis
questions_to_ask: 'What patterns do you notice in your relationships?'
'Does the description of your 'ideal partner' (7th house) match who you actually attract?'

section_3_career.title: Career and Life Direction
talking_points: MC sign: 'This is your public reputation, career direction, legacy'
10th house ruler placement: 'This shows where your career manifests'
2nd house and ruler: 'This is how you make money, your resources'
6th house: 'This is your daily work style, health, service'
Vocational indicators: planets in 10th, MC ruler, Saturn
Sun-Saturn aspects: authority and career development timeline
Jupiter placements: expansion and opportunity areas
section_3_career.practical_guidance: Discuss specific career fields that match chart patterns

section_4_life_purpose.title: Life Purpose and Growth Direction
talking_points: North Node sign and house: 'This is your growth direction, what you're developing'
South Node: 'These are your natural gifts and comfort zone you're evolving beyond'
Saturn sign and house: 'These are your major life lessons and where you build mastery'
Chart ruler placement: 'This ties your whole chart together, showing life direction'
Dominant element/modality: 'This is your natural operating style'
Major aspect patterns: T-square, Grand Trine, etc.

section_5_challenges_and_growth.title: Challenges and Growth Opportunities
talking_points: Difficult aspects: frame as growth opportunities, not problems
Saturn placements: lessons and mastery timeline
Chiron: 'This is your wound and your healing gift'
Challenging planet placements: 'These are areas requiring conscious development'
12th house themes: shadow work and transcendence
Always frame positively: 'Every challenge is an opportunity for growth'
section_5_challenges_and_growth.therapeutic_note: If serious trauma indicators (Pluto-Moon square, 12th house emphasis, etc.), suggest professional therapy support

section_6_timing_preview.title: Current Timing and Near Future
talking_points: Major current transits affecting chart
Saturn cycle position (pre/post Saturn return)
Jupiter transits: opportunities in next year
Progressed Moon: current emotional focus
Annual profection: this year's focus house
Upcoming eclipses: activation points
section_6_timing_preview.bridge_to_predictive: If client wants more timing work, offer separate predictive consultation

talking_points: Ask: 'What resonated most? What surprised you?'
Summarize key themes: 'Your main gifts are..., your challenges are..., your path forward involves...'
Answer remaining questions
Provide actionable guidance based on chart
Offer recording or written report
Discuss follow-up consultation options (timing, relationship synastry, etc.)
Thank client and close

post_consultation.written_report: Send PDF summary with key points, chart image, and any recommendations
post_consultation.follow_up: Email check-in after 1 week to see if questions arose

talking_points: Welcome both partners (if present) or explain reading for absent partner
Explain synastry: 'We compare your charts to see how you interact energetically'
Set expectations: show strengths, challenges, and growth opportunities
Ask relationship status and main concerns
Assure confidentiality if one partner absent

section_1_individual_summaries.title: Individual Relationship Styles
talking_points: Person A's Venus/Mars/7th house: relationship needs and style
Person B's Venus/Mars/7th house: relationship needs and style
Point out similarities and differences
'You both need X' or 'One needs Y while the other needs Z'

section_2_major_connections.title: Your Connection: Major Aspects
priority_aspects: Venus-Mars aspects: romantic and sexual chemistry
interpretation_guidelines: Start with harmonious aspects (trines, sextiles) to build positive frame
Present challenging aspects (squares, oppositions) as 'growth areas'
Explain double whammies: 'This connection goes both ways, so it's especially powerful'
Use practical examples: 'This means when she's upset, you might feel...'
Check for aspect chains connecting multiple planets

section_3_house_overlays.title: How You Experience Each Other
talking_points: Person A's planets in Person B's houses:
Focus on personal planets (Sun, Moon, Venus, Mars, Mercury)
Emphasize 1st, 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th, 10th, 11th house overlays
Person B's planets in Person A's houses:
Explain: 'When your Venus is in their 7th house, they see you as their ideal partner'
'Your Sun in their 5th house means you bring them joy and creativity'
Check for reciprocal overlays: both in each other's 7th, etc.

section_4_composite_chart.title: The Relationship Itself
talking_points: Composite Sun: 'This is the heart of your relationship, its purpose'
Composite Moon: 'This is the emotional climate between you'
Composite Venus: 'This is how love expresses in the relationship'
Composite Mars: 'This is how you handle conflict and passion'
Composite Saturn: 'These are the relationship's challenges and lessons'
Composite 7th house: 'This is how the relationship presents to others'

section_5_compatibility_scores.title: Compatibility Assessment
provide: Explain: 'These scores are guidelines, not destiny. Every relationship takes work.'

section_6_strengths_and_challenges.title: Your Relationship's Gifts and Growth Areas
strengths: List 3-5 major strengths from chart analysis
challenges: Frame as growth opportunities: 'This square means you'll grow through...'
Provide practical advice for each challenge
Example: 'Mars square Mars means you might compete or clash. Try: channeling this into playful competition or separate activities for individual expression.'

section_7_relationship_timing.title: Relationship Timing and Development
talking_points: Current transits to relationship points
Composite chart transits
Saturn cycles in relationship
Upcoming eclipses affecting relationship houses
If asked about marriage: check 7th house progressions, Lot of Marriage transits
Summary: 'Your relationship's core dynamic is...'
Answer questions from both partners
Emphasize: 'Astrology shows potentials. Your choices and commitment create the reality.'
Provide actionable relationship advice based on charts
Discuss follow-up options (timing for relationship events, etc.)
Thank clients

ethical_considerations: Never predict breakup or divorce—present challenges only
If one partner is absent, maintain confidentiality
If relationship is toxic (severe Pluto-Moon, Mars-Pluto hard aspects), gently suggest counseling
Emphasize free will and personal responsibility
Don't take sides if both present

talking_points: Ask about specific questions or time periods of interest
Explain multiple timing techniques: 'We'll look at transits, progressions, and solar return'
Set expectations: astrology shows timing of themes, not guaranteed events
Ask about past major events to validate timing techniques

section_1_past_validation.title: Validating Timing in Your Past
method: Check major transits for past 2-3 years
Note Saturn/Uranus/Neptune/Pluto transits to angles or personal planets
Ask if client remembers what was happening during those times
Build trust by demonstrating timing accuracy
Example: 'In March 2023, Pluto was exactly on your Venus. Did something intense happen in relationships?'

section_2_current_transits.title: Current Energies and Themes
cover: All current outer planet transits (Jupiter through Pluto)
Solar return chart for current year
Emphasize themes that multiple techniques confirm

section_3_next_12_months.title: The Year Ahead
month_by_month: Highlight best times for: new beginnings, important decisions, romance, career moves
Note challenging periods and how to navigate
Check for Saturn returns, Jupiter returns, nodal returns
Solar return analysis for upcoming birthday
section_3_next_12_months.provide_written: Month-by-month summary of key dates and themes

section_4_major_life_cycles.title: Long-Term Cycles and Themes
cover: Saturn cycle position (approaching/past Saturn return, square, opposition)

section_5_specific_questions.title: Timing Your Questions

common_questions.career_change: Check transits to 10th house, MC, 10th ruler, Saturn, Jupiter
common_questions.relationship: Check 7th house, Venus, Lot of Marriage, progressed Venus
common_questions.moving: Check 4th house, IC, transits to Moon
common_questions.pregnancy: Check 5th house, Jupiter-Moon contacts, progressed Moon in 5th
common_questions.health: Check 6th house, progressed planets in 6th, Mars-Saturn transits

section_5_specific_questions.provide_specific_timing: Give 2-3 optimal timing windows for client's goals

talking_points: Summarize major themes for next year
Provide list of key dates
Emphasize both opportunities and challenges
Remind: 'You have free will within these cycles'
Suggest: 'Let's check in again in 6-12 months to see how things unfolded'
Answer remaining questions

deliverables: Best timing windows for specific goals

opening.get_clear_question: What is your specific question? (More specific = better answer)

natal_factors.examine: Relevant natal chart factors for question
natal_factors.example: For career question: Sun, MC, 10th house, Saturn, Jupiter, 2nd house

preparation: Study chart for at least 1 hour before meeting
Have chart printed or on large screen

communication_skills: Speak clearly and avoid jargon (or explain it)
Ask if client understands before moving on
Watch client's body language for engagement
Pause for client questions and reflections
Take brief notes of client's feedback
Manage time to cover all sections
ethical_guidelines: Never predict death or severe illness
Don't give medical, legal, or financial advice

follow_up: Note any rectification insights from client feedback

pricing_factors: Complexity (synastry more complex than single chart)

marketing_templates.natal_chart_description: A complete natal chart consultation explores your birth chart to reveal your personality, life purpose, relationships, career path, and growth opportunities. You'll receive deep insight into your strengths, challenges, and the unique gifts you came here to express. Perfect for self-discovery and life direction.
marketing_templates.synastry_description: Relationship compatibility analysis compares two birth charts to show how you connect, where you harmonize, and where you challenge each other to grow. Discover your relationship's strengths, navigate challenges with awareness, and understand the deeper purpose of your connection.
marketing_templates.predictive_description: A timing consultation looks at your upcoming transits, progressions, and cycles to show what energies and opportunities are coming. Receive guidance on the best times for major decisions, relationship developments, career moves, and personal growth. Plan your year with cosmic awareness.
